correctness.rationale: The left multiplications commute and commutators act trivially on the left, so the product is pre-Lie; t·(t·v)=T²v≠0=(t·t)·v demonstrates nonassociativity. Writing N(v)=f(v)t+Sv, the t-coordinate of the torsion on (v,w) gives f(v)f(Tw)=0 for all v,w; invertibility forces f=0. The (t,t) and (t,w) equations then give BTu=B[T,B]=0 for B=S−aI, and the other pairs vanish. For rank-one B=v⊗φ the equation is φ(Tv)φ=φ(v)φT. If φ(v)=0 then φ annihilates both v and Tv, impossible for irreducible T; otherwise φ is a forbidden rational eigenfunctional. Invertible B commutes with T and forces u=0. The centralizer is the field k[T] (a vector and its T-image are a cyclic basis), giving exactly the stated rational union and rank counts. For split T=diag(λ,μ) with nonzero distinct entries and B=[[p,r],[s,h]], the equations reduce to pr=rs=hs=0 and BTu=0. Separating r≠0, s≠0 and diagonal B gives the four listed maximal linear spaces, of dimensions 3,3,4,4; the assertion is about the reduced locus. For a fixed a≠0 the ranks are 1+rank(aI+B); rank 3 has Q²+(Q−2)²+2Q(Q−2)+2Q(Q−1)² choices, and rank 2 has 2Q²+2Q−4. For a=0 the rank is rank([u B]); rank 2 has (Q−1)²+2(Q−1)²+2(Q−1)³ choices. These counts and subtraction agree with the split polynomial. Frobenius exchanges eigenlines and the two larger components. Irreducibility persists in odd-degree extensions, and formal logarithms give 2Q³+(−1)^sQ+1_(s even)(2Q⁴−4Q²), exactly the stated counts. Independent direct evaluation of the bilinear torsion on all nine ordered basis pairs reproduced 14, 51 and 183 for the respective F₂ irreducible and F₃ irreducible and split actions, and 580 with rank counts (1,66,189,324) after base-changing the same F₂ action to F₄. These finite checks do not establish the geometric statement or arbitrary-q proof, and no scheme-theoretic reducedness is inferred.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: With two distinct split eigenlines the square-zero equations force v to span one eigenline, ker φ that line, and u on it. The eigenline branch likewise gives ker φ an eigenline and u on it; the two cases together give all nonzero B vanishing on that line with u on it. Their closures are exactly the two four-spaces, one per line. The zero-deviation space is already covered, and invertible deviations have u=0 and form the open invertible subset of the diagonal centralizer, whose closure is the remaining three-space. Frobenius permutes the two eigenlines, so extension parity gives the asserted two counts from the already determined rank strata and the displayed elementary complement. Their logarithmic generating function gives the zeta mechanically. Thus the unrestricted and reduced geometric claims, although not stated in the comparator, are immediate consequences in this dimension, not independent refinements of it.
